title: 06 Plenary: a Memphis landing section for conference ticketing
strengths: The Memphis set is data: each big shape is a ticket type drawn to scale by tickets sold (early bird 400, standard 1,212, workshop 186, comps 64), and the same shapes mark the tiers in the product
Real organiser UI shown flat and whole: Northfold Design Week 2027, 1,862 of 2,520 sold, a tier bar, four ticket rows with prices and closing dates, EUR 647,360 gross, next payout Fri 13 Nov
Disciplined palette: lemon, pink and mint on black and white; patterns only on shapes, never behind text; one action plus a price
slop_signals: The standard hero recipe: two-line headline with the second line bold ('From early bird to / last badge.'), a sub-line, a filled button plus an underlined link, then three small facts
A floating product card on the right with shapes around it; the speaker square is almost hidden behind the card and the pink half-disc is cut by the fold, so the 'to scale' idea cannot be seen
A footnote ('The shapes are the four ticket types, drawn to scale by tickets sold') has to explain the concept; a shipped page would not
The squiggle and the zigzag are admitted decoration with no data
fixes: Set the four shapes side by side, unobstructed and labelled, as the sales chart itself, and drop the footnote
Remove the squiggle and zigzag; let the ticket shapes be the only Memphis marks
Break the recipe: one action, and put a real event photograph or the badge itself where the facts row is

references.what: Organiser landing page: feature list beside the product on a colour field
Ticketing hero with real event cards instead of decoration
Decorative stars and hexagons around a headline: the scattered-shape version to avoid

changed: Rebuilt around one idea: each ticket type has a shape, printed on every badge for room-door checks, and the same shapes chart sales
The four shapes stand unobstructed on one floor, labelled, at 50 px² per ticket: filled = issued, dashed open outline = released; equal 56 px gaps; legend in the totals column, no footnote
Every pattern covers 20% of its shape and stays 3 px off the edges, so the visible colour is to scale
A flat badge (standard + workshop, Room 3, Fri 10:00) replaces the floating product card; squiggle, zigzag and facts row removed
Default hero recipe broken: one regular-weight headline, one action, price as text; wordmark, button and focus ring black and white so colour means ticket type only
1,862 issued of 2,520 released (1,676 people + 186 workshop seats), EUR 647,360 gross; next payout Fri 16 Oct 2026 (was 13 Nov, against 'every Friday')
Event renamed Kanteel Design Week 2027 in Ghent, Hall 4 (Northfold was the seventh North- name; Rotterdam reused); engine pick Q-dir-01 memphis
The lanyard strap is gone (it repeated styles/03); the hero object is now Room 3's door sign, a large striped mint triangle at an angle, with the attendee badge leaning on it
Headline at the scale's 90 px display size, so the page has one display word; lede shortened; 56 px from the action to the chart
Dots, squiggles, stripes and zigzags drawn as whole glyphs 4 px inside each shape, on the chart and the badge; speakers and press get a zigzag
Chart at 28 px² per ticket on a floor at y 768; labels at 16 px with 12 px captions, clear of the margin and of each other
Totals as aligned rows beside the chart, starting on its title line and ending on its floor; "1,862" at 38 px
A neutral issued/released key beside the chart title; badge at 240 x 320 with "Type designer" (Studio Veldkant no longer on the page)

references.what: Shapes set inside the display line, so word and object read as one
One display word and one drawn object on a dark ground
Real Memphis: black-and-white patterns, tilt and collisions
